known_issues: All cases read assets patched in one boot by one fixture pack (tests/probe-pack); the patches are independent (one change each), so a failing group does not stop the others from applying.
The tokenised-key probe uses dynamic tokens only; immutable tokens in nested keys are resolved at parse time and work in the starter, so they are not a discriminating probe.

The position group probes Vector2 only. The reference routes conversion through SMAPI's own JSON serializer, which also covers Point, Rectangle and Color; an implementation that handles only Vector2 passes the suite.
The reference (upstream 4a12c9af7) reads SMAPI's internal toolkit through reflection; the alternative control shows an implementation without internal access also satisfies every case.
